rationale: A burst supply line within the policyholder's home caused water damage to their own basement structure and contents, fitting the definition of property damage.
claim_summary: Policyholder Sam Patel (POL-1004) returned from a work trip to find their basement flooded with approximately two inches of water caused by a burst supply line under the upstairs bathroom sink that ran for about two days. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall (up to one foot), and ruined stored items. Estimated damages likely exceed $25,000; high-priority on-site assessment and mitigation needed.

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure with no injuries is straightforward property damage.
claim_summary: Jordan Lee, POL-1006: Wind damage last weekend blew approximately four shingles off the back porch overhang; no water intrusion or other damage reported. Estimated repair cost: $400. Deductible: $2,500 (claim is below deductible threshold).
